issues.title: [Shortcut Guide] Hold-Win activation throws NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected

en.headline: 15 own commits plus 21 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **15 own commits** were made across `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` and `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, plus 21 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report`, work covered mobile table cards and 375/414 viewport adaptation, removal of orphaned theme CSS, a single-button theme switcher with an SVG favicon, and visual refinements such as gradient top lines, KPI color bars, zebra striping, and navigation underlines. The same repository also merged three plugins into the resource inventory, corrected automation attribution, added a GitHub repository button, `LICENSE`, `.gitattributes`, and GitHub Pages publishing documentation, and removed the section on how suggestions are formed. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, documentation updates removed historical worktree path references, dropped the OpenChamber prerequisite from horizontal evaluations, added external document sources with four evidence levels, and recorded memory mechanisms, DSH `run_code` dual channels, plugin package names, and keyless search options. The user opened or closed **1 issue**: `microsoft/PowerToys` issue #52004, “[Shortcut Guide] Hold-Win activation throws NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected”. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 15 次本人提交，另有 21 次自动提交，分布于三个仓库
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 和 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 完成 **15 次本人提交**，另有 21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 的改动涵盖移动端表格卡片与 375/414 视口适配、清理旧主题控件的孤儿 CSS、将主题切换改为单按钮加弹出菜单并补充 SVG favicon，以及渐变顶线、KPI 色条、斑马纹和导航下划线等视觉精修。该仓库还将 3 个插件并入资料库清单、修正 automation 归属，新增 GitHub 仓库按钮、`LICENSE`、`.gitattributes` 和 GitHub Pages 发布说明，并删除建议的形成方式小节。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的文档更新清除了工作树路径的历史残留，移除了横向评测中的 OpenChamber 前提，补充外部文档来源与四档证据等级，并收录记忆机制、DSH `run_code` 双通道、插件包名核实和免 Key 搜索选型。用户新开或关闭了 **1 个 issue**：`microsoft/PowerToys` 的 #52004“[Shortcut Guide] Hold-Win activation throws NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected”。当日没有 pull request、review、发布或讨论记录。
